title: Killing Sin Isn't a Willpower Problem
caption:
You don't manage an enemy. You put it down.

Struggle-language lets you lose slowly and still feel okay about it. Scripture doesn't say tame your sin, it says put it to death, and that's a different fight entirely: cut the supply line before you're tired, say the true sentence to one man before shame gets to keep it, and expect a daily rep, not a one-time win.

"Put to death therefore what is earthly in you." Colossians 3:5
